title: Page 4
content_zh:
她、一、定、是、故、意、的！
明明知道这个女人是故意在整他，但戚无雍却还是只能勉强扯了扯嘴角，僵起笑脸说：「下次可以麻烦你讲快一点吗？」
「我正要讲，可是却被你给打断了，下次可以麻烦你有耐心一点吗？」
他错了，不该以为她只是个小姑娘，没什么好怕的，太轻敌的下场就是他现在这个样子，简直丢脸丢到家了！
他发誓，只要一有机会，他也要让这个女人吃吃苦头，彻底回敬她一顿。
戚无雍一边后悔之际，倒开始忍不住纳闷，他是哪里得罪这个女人了，要不然她为什么会对他带有敌意，甚至还这样子耍他？
说不通呀，在这之前，他和她可是素未谋面过，又怎么有办法结得了怨，而且看她耍人的狠劲，这个怨仇还真是不浅呢！
「啧，我这一路上到底是在倒什么楣呀……」
正当戚无雍暗自咕哝低咒时，燕晓苗突然指着左手边的密林，兴奋地介绍道：「这里就是我们珍贵茶种生长的林区，也是燕族自古以来最重要的圣地。」
「终于到了？」
他们马上将视线投到一旁烟雾弥漫的密林当中，心想一路上听燕晓苗讲了那么一长串废话，现在可终于到了，还真是不容易呀。
小舟一靠岸，戚无雍率先跳下船，其他保镳们也赶紧跟着下来，往前稍微走了几步，只见密林内百树丛生，杂乱不已，完全不像普通茶园同种茶树聚生在一起的模样，连到底哪株是茶树、哪株不是都分不清楚，这该如果寻找珍贵茶种？
看来还是需要当地族人帮忙才行，戚无雍转身说道：「燕姑娘，还是得麻烦你……嗄？」
他不看还好，一看才发现原来燕晓苗根本就没有下舟来，还拚命使眼色叫船夫赶紧把舟划走，因为他们已经功成身退，打算要撤退了。
「等等，站住！」戚无雍马上奔到河岸旁，简直是怒不可遏。「你这是在做什么，快给我回来！」
「戚公子，再告诉你一件我们燕族的风土民情。」
瞧着小舟划离河岸，顺着水流迅速往下游走，离戚无雍一行人越来越远，燕晓苗那得逞的笑容就越发灿烂。
「那就是呀……燕族的人是非常忠诚，不会打破自家规矩的，所以下次如果有人再这样骗你，别再傻傻的上当啦！」喔呵呵呵呵呵……
果然这个女人从头到尾都是不怀好意，打定主意要玩死他！
「你……你这个该死的女人，别让我有机会活着逮住你——」

听着戚无雍那气到拚命狂叫嚣的声音，燕晓苗更是乐了，身心简直是畅快不已，连半点心虚都没有。
他们就好好的在这座迷林里迷个几天路、捱个几顿饿吧，等她姑娘心情好的时候，自会派人把他们给拎回燕族村落的。
哼哼哼，敢打他们燕族主意的人，就是这等下场！
第2章(1)
戚无雍才刚来燕云山作客，第二天就马上失去踪影，这让燕族长百思不得其解，不懂自家的贵客到底跑到哪里去玩了？
一连三天，戚无雍连半个影子都没有出现，这让燕族长开始心慌，急着到处找人，他动员许多族人，几乎都快把整个燕族村落给翻过一遍，却还是连戚无雍的一块衣角也找不到，真是邪门呀！
怪怪了，他们燕云山可从没发生过这种神秘失踪事件，这下可好了，丢的不是他们自己的族人，而是从京城来的贵客，还是让他们能够安稳生活不愁吃穿的大金主，这下子他该怎样向戚家的大公子交代才好？
「惨了惨了，燕云山这附近根本没什么好游玩的地方，戚四公子到底是跑到哪儿去了呢……」
瞧着自家爹爹担心地在厅内走来走去，都快愁白了头发，燕茗有些心虚地赶紧来到燕晓苗所住的院落，急着想知道戚无雍的下落。
「晓苗姊！」
「燕茗，怎么啦？」燕晓苗轻哼着曲调，在庭院里呵护她的爱花。
「你……你快带戚公子他们回来吧。」身为共犯，胆子比较小的燕茗是越来越担心她们俩所做的好事被拆穿，如果不是燕晓苗坚持要好好整治戚无雍一顿，或许也就不会有现在这些事情了。
「为什么？才三天而已，让他们再多吃几天苦头，我再考虑要不要把他们给带回来。」
「晓苗姊，三天就已经够多了啦，戚家和燕族毕竟还有买卖往来，别做得太过火。」
对于燕茗的说法，燕晓苗非常的不以为然。「是啦，戚家是我们燕族赖以为生的大金主，但这样就能随意欺负人吗？我不服！」
「可是……」
「欺负人？你倒是说说看，我从踏入燕云山的那一刻起，哪里欺负过你们燕族的人了，你说呀！」
「嗄？」
那带火的低沉嗓音突然凭空冒出来，让燕晓苗和燕茗都吓了一大跳，她们赶紧转过身，就见应该还在森林中迷路的戚无雍出现了，完完全全出乎她们的预料！
他身上的锦服充满像是被荆棘丛林蹂躏过的破烂痕迹，表情阴寒得像刚从地狱里爬出来一样，那一双锐眼狠狠地瞪着燕晓苗，虽然狼狈至极，但那骇人的气势却更是可怕，让人忍不住想拔腿就跑！

「啊——他居然回来了、回来了——」
两个小姑娘吓得马上转身就跑，像是见鬼了一样，结果下一瞬间，四道身影咻咻咻地挡在她们俩面前，将她们逃跑的路给完全堵死，那保镳脸上的表情活像勾魂使者一样，显然对她们俩也是怨念深厚。
「啊——救命呀——」
好姊妹吓得再转个方向想逃跑，结果却被保镳们给掐住衣领哪里也跑不了，就像是孤魂野鬼被牢牢地拎住，即将呜呼哀哉了。
可终于逮到这两个阴险无比的小姑娘了！戚无雍来到燕晓苗面前，扬起一抹冷笑。「还记得我说过的话吗？别让我有机会活着逮住你，要不然……」
在经过了三天三夜的迷路及捱饿受冻，他们好不容易才找到出林的路，回到燕族村落，一想起那三天的非人待遇，他说什么都不会放过燕晓苗，一定也要让她尝尝苦头才肯罢休！
敢这样整他，就别怪他以牙还牙、以眼还眼，管她是男是女、是老是少！
燕晓苗虽然非常害怕，却还是倔强地开口：「你……你这个坏人，你到底想怎样？」
「我是坏人？」戚无雍纳闷地挑了下眉。
「是，别以为装得一脸无辜样，就可以掩饰过去你是坏人的事实！」
「……」有没有搞错，他可是受害者呀！
「晓苗姊，别……别再说了啦……」
瞧戚无雍的脸色是越来越可怕，燕茗害怕地连忙阻止。「我们俩现在可是在他手上，只要他一个不高兴，你和我就准备去见燕族的列祖列宗了……」呜呜……她还不想红颜薄命呀……
「怎么了，到底发生什么事了？」
一听到别院传来凄厉骇人的尖叫声，燕族长慌张的狂奔过来。「戚四公子？你可终于出现了！啊……你抓着她们俩是……」
「燕族长，你来得正好！」戚无雍非常火的指着燕晓苗鼻头。「你自己问问她们俩，这就是你们燕族的待客之道，真是让人不敢领教！」
「嗄？」到底发生什么事了？
燕族长是完全处于状况外，戚无雍只好耐着性子将燕晓苗把他骗到深山内，放他自生自灭的可恶行径一五一十全部说出，要他来评评理。
content_en:
She, one, definitely, is, intentionally, intended!
He clearly knew that this woman was deliberately teasing him, but Qi Wuyong could only forcefully twitch his lips, put on a smile and said, "Can I trouble you to speak faster next time?"
"I was about to speak, but you interrupted me. Can I ask you to be more patient next time?"
He was wrong. He shouldn't have thought that she was just a little girl and had nothing to be afraid of. The result of underestimating the enemy was that he was like this now. He was so embarrassed and humiliated!
He swore that whenever he got the chance, he would make this woman suffer and repay her completely.
While Qi Wuyong was regretting it, he couldn't help but wonder, where did he offend this woman? Otherwise, why would she be hostile to him and even play tricks on him like this?
It doesn't make sense. Before this, he and she had never met, so how could they have a grudge? Moreover, looking at her ruthlessness in playing tricks, this grudge is really not shallow!
"Tsk, what kind of trouble have I been doing along the way..."
Just as Qi Wuyong was muttering a curse to himself, Yan Xiaomiao suddenly pointed to the dense forest on the left and introduced excitedly: "This is the forest area where our precious tea seeds grow, and it is also the most important sacred place of the Yan tribe since ancient times."
"Finally here?"
They immediately cast their sights into the smoky dense forest nearby, thinking that Yan Xiaomiao had talked a long list of nonsense along the way, and now that they were finally here, it was really not easy.
As soon as the boat docked, Qi Wuyong was the first to jump out of the boat. The other guards quickly followed and walked a few steps forward. They saw hundreds of trees in the dense forest, which were very messy. It was not like the same tea trees of the same species growing together in ordinary tea gardens. It was not clear which one was a tea tree and which one was not. How should we look for precious tea seeds?
It seems that we still need help from the local tribesmen. Qi Wuyong turned around and said, "Miss Yan, I still have to trouble you... huh?"
It was a good thing that he didn't look, but when he looked, he realized that Yan Xiaomiao had not gotten out of the boat at all. She even winked at the boatman and told the boatman to row the boat away quickly, because they had already succeeded and planned to retreat.
"Wait, stop!" Qi Wuyong immediately ran to the river bank, furious. "What are you doing? Come back here!"
"Master Qi, let me tell you one more thing about our Yan people's customs."
Watching the small boat row away from the river bank and quickly downstream along the current, Li Qi Wuyong and his party were getting farther and farther away, and Yan Xiaomiao's successful smile became brighter.
"That's right... People of the Yan tribe are very loyal and will not break their own rules, so next time if someone lies to you like this, don't be fooled again!" Oh hehehehe...
Sure enough, this woman had evil intentions from beginning to end and was determined to kill him!
"You...you damn woman, don't let me catch you alive——"
Listening to Qi Wuyong's voice that was so angry that he was shouting like crazy, Yan Xiaomiao was even more happy. Her body and mind were so happy that she didn't even feel guilty at all.
They can just get lost in this dense forest for a few days and eat a few hungry meals. When the girl is in a good mood, she will send someone to take them back to the Yan tribe's village.
Hehe hehe, anyone who dares to attack the Yan clan will end up like this!
Chapter 2(1)
Qi Wuyong had just come to Yanyun Mountain as a guest and disappeared immediately the next day. This made the Yan clan leader puzzled. He didn't know where his distinguished guest went to play.
For three days in a row, Qi Wuyong didn't show up even half a shadow. This made the leader of the Yan tribe start to panic, and he was anxious to look for someone everywhere. He mobilized many tribesmen and almost went through the entire Yan tribe village, but he still couldn't find even a corner of Qi Wuyong's clothes. What an evil thing!
It's strange. They have never had such a mysterious disappearance in Yanyun Mountain. What's better now is that it's not their own clansmen who are missing, but distinguished guests from the capital.He was the big benefactor who allowed them to live a stable life without worrying about food and clothing. How should he explain to the eldest son of the Qi family now?
"It's terrible, it's terrible. There is no fun place to visit near Yanyun Mountain. Where did Master Qi go..."
Seeing her father walking around the hall worriedly, his hair almost turning gray with worry, Yan Ming hurried to the courtyard where Yan Xiaomiao lived with a guilty conscience, anxious to know the whereabouts of Qi Wuyong.
"Sister Xiaomiao!"
"Yan Ming, what's wrong?" Yan Xiaomiao hummed softly, caring for her beloved flowers in the courtyard.
"You... bring Mr. Qi and the others back quickly." As an accomplice, Yan Ming, who was timid, was increasingly worried that the good deeds they had done would be revealed. If Yan Xiaomiao hadn't insisted on giving Qi Wuyong a good punishment, perhaps these things wouldn't have happened now.
"Why? It's only been three days. Let them suffer for a few more days before I consider whether to bring them back."
"Sister Xiaomiao, three days is enough. After all, the Qi family and the Yan clan still have business relationships, so don't go too far."
Yan Xiaomiao was very dissatisfied with Yan Ming's statement. "Yes, the Qi family is the main financial backer on which our Yan clan depends for our livelihood, but does this allow us to bully others at will? I don't accept it!"
"But..."
"Bullying people? Tell me, from the moment I stepped into Yanyun Mountain, where have I ever bullied you, the Yan people? Tell me!"
"Huh?"
The fiery deep voice suddenly appeared out of thin air, startling both Yan Xiaomiao and Yan Ming. They quickly turned around and saw Qi Wuyong, who was probably still lost in the forest, appearing, completely beyond their expectations!
The brocade clothes on his body were full of tattered traces as if they had been ravaged by a thorny jungle, and his expression was as cold as if he had just crawled out of hell. His sharp eyes glared at Yan Xiaomiao fiercely. Although he was extremely embarrassed, his terrifying momentum was even more terrifying, making people want to run away!
"Ah - he's actually back, he's back -"
The two little girls were so frightened that they immediately turned around and ran away, as if they had seen a ghost. However, in the next moment, four figures stood in front of them, completely blocking their escape route. The expression on the guard's face was like a seductress, and he obviously had deep resentment towards them both.
"Ah - help -"
The good sister was so frightened that she turned around and tried to escape, but the guards grabbed her collar and couldn't run away. She was like a lonely ghost being held tightly, and was about to die.
But finally we caught these two insidious little girls! Qi Wuyong came to Yan Xiaomiao and raised a sneer. "Remember what I said? Don't let me catch you alive, otherwise..."
After three days and nights of getting lost, starving and freezing, they finally found their way out of the forest and returned to the Yan village. Thinking of the inhumane treatment during those three days, he said that he would never let Yan Xiaomiao go, and he would not let her go until she tasted the pain!
If you dare to punish him like this, don't blame him for fighting tooth for tooth, eye for eye, no matter whether she is male or female, old or young!
Although Yan Xiaomiao was very scared, she still said stubbornly: "You... you are a bad person, what do you want?"
"Am I a bad person?" Qi Wuyong raised his eyebrows in confusion.
"Yes, don't think that pretending to be innocent can hide the fact that you were a bad person in the past!"
"..." Am I mistaken? He is the victim!
"Sister Xiaomiao, don't... stop talking..."
Seeing that Qi Wuyong's face was getting more and more scary, Yan Ming stopped him in fear. "The two of us are in his hands now. As long as he is unhappy, you and I will be ready to meet the ancestors of the Yan tribe..." Wuwu... She doesn't want her beauty to die...
"What's wrong? What happened?"
As soon as he heard the shrill and terrifying screams coming from the other courtyard, Chief Yan panicked.Zhang ran over wildly. "Fourth Young Master Qi? You finally showed up! Ah...you caught them both..."
"Chief Yan, you came just in time!" Qi Wuyong pointed at Yan Xiaomiao's nose angrily. "Ask them both yourself, this is the way your Yan people treat guests. It's really hard for people to learn from you!"
"Huh?" What happened?
Chief Yan was completely out of the situation, so Qi Wuyong had no choice but to patiently trick Yan Xiaomiao into hiding in the mountains and let him fend for himself, telling him all about his abominable behavior and asking him to comment.
